why: The one surviving case where the periodic peak crosses the limit while the time-mean steady peak does not. Pinned here as structured data so neither the driver nor the renderer regex-parses prose, and so both read ONE copy.

grid128_row.note: Externally supplied. grid128-max has NOT been run as a factorial; its registered argmax differs from grid64's and moves between the two semantics.

earlier_hotspot_binary_sha256.note: The binary used by the earlier transient work. A run whose staged binary hashes to this value cannot be an independent numerical confirmation of that work's numbers -- identical inputs through an identical binary are arithmetically determined to agree.

citation_contract: Each cited document/line must still contain the values recorded beside it; the renderer refuses otherwise. Line numbers drift when the cited document is edited -- this record was already wrong once within an hour of being written.
